definitions: All candidate financial results are pre-holdout research observations, not forecasts.
Annual arithmetic return increments are distinct from CAGR.
Fees are divided by the fixed £250 opening equity and actual test elapsed years; this is a diagnostic, not a continuous-portfolio cost attribution.
Exposure is weighted by fold elapsed days.
Episode totals across correlated variants are not independent samples.
Open-quantity counts include ordinary positions and possible sub-minimum residuals.
Ten-episode durations simply extrapolate observed episode frequency and are not waiting-time forecasts.

synthetic_probes.comment: The reference always uses the protection minimum as the exit once a later opening bid permits it. This is a documented pessimistic convention, not evidence about the actual intrabar fill.
